summary: ECARX Holdings filed a Form 6-K confirming completion of its all-cash acquisition of 100% of Hubei Qiguang Technology Co., Ltd., the DreamSmart carve-out holding the Flyme Auto and Flyme OS software businesses, first announced June 22, 2026. Total consideration was RMB1.8 billion (about US$266 million), against an independent May 31, 2026 valuation of RMB1.824 billion. Funding is roughly 70% syndicated Chinese bank loans with 10-year maturity and 30% internal cash, plus a RMB200 million post-closing capital injection. Flyme becomes an independent software division; watch integration execution, leverage, and software-licensing monetization.
